about_short_description.short_description: Merit Incentives is an engagement technology company.

product.name: Customer Loyalty Solutions
product.description: A platform to create and manage customer loyalty programs that increase engagement and retention through customized campaigns and instant rewards.

product.name: Employee Engagement Platform
product.description: A system to recognize and reward employees, improving productivity and morale through meaningful rewards and recognition.

product.name: Points Exchange
product.description: A platform enabling members to transfer loyalty points between programs and redeem them seamlessly via real-time API integration.

product.name: Loyalty Management Solution
product.description: A unified system to manage all aspects of loyalty programs, including rules, campaigns, and points distribution and redemption.

product.name: Loyalty Marketplace
product.description: A white-labelled B2B loyalty and rewards marketplace with its own points engine, campaigns, and payment solutions.

product.name: Create Your Own Gift Card
product.description: A service to instantly create and sell branded gift cards to both B2C and B2B customers.
